csp.text: Haakon is the general for whom Heidar raises an army of bones, and Heidar, saying that Tresserhorn is theirs now, tells him to dredge the lake there for bones.
Martyrs are sacrificed to the Frost Marsh to raise Haakon's army, while Heidar allies with the Order of Stromgald and Krov to locate relics and gain protection from New Argive.
On the last day of the Battle of Kjeldor, King Darien joins the fight and defeats Haakon, ending the battle.
